content:
kristen_cs: forwarding — Novatech (PO NT-2024-55) says the enterprise credit from their signed contract never showed up in billing, and they're also seeing intermittent 401s when calling the API with the enterprise key. customer attached invoice and a screenshot. ticket: CS-4521
eli_sales: thanks. I created the promo in our system (promo_id: PROMO-NT-Q2) and marked the PO note on the sales record. I thought the billing job would auto-apply on next invoice but apparently not. cc @jamie_billing
jamie_billing: can you paste the org_id and latest invoice id? need to check ledger entries and whether credit was issued vs queued.
kristen_cs: org_id: org_00987_novatech, last_invoice: INV-2024-07-889. Customer says invoice still shows full charge.
jamie_billing: thanks. pulling ledger now. if the promo was created after invoice generation it won't retroactively apply without manual grant. sending steps to grant now.
sam_eng: re: 401s/latency — do we have request_ids or timestamps? could be API key rotation or transient auth error. need a minimal repro. kristen_cs can you ask customer for a curl snippet they used?
kristen_cs: they sent this (redacted key):
```bash
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <ENTERPRISE_KEY>" -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
```
they got: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized and a few 504 timeouts earlier today.
sam_eng: ok two buckets: 401 = key invalid/disabled or wrong org header; 504/latency = gateway timeout during a heavy batch window. i'll look at gateway logs for org_00987_novatech around 2024-05-02T14:00Z. can you confirm if they're using the org-bound key or a project key?
kristen_cs: customer says it's their enterprise key they were given in onboarding.
eli_sales: i see in the sales record that we issued two different keys during onboarding; possible they tried the old rotated one. i just DM'd the customer to confirm which key.
ops-bot: [automated] fairing-gateway logs archived for org_00987_novatech at 2024-05-02T13:50:00Z - 2024-05-02T15:10:00Z, link: https://logs.internal/redwood/org_00987_novatech/20240502
jamie_billing: ledger shows no credit applied to INV-2024-07-889. promo PROMO-NT-Q2 is active but credit entry was created with status "pending_review" due to missing PO note on the invoice metadata. sales added note now — I can run a manual grant. amount = USD 25,000 (per contract). confirm and I'll apply ledger adjustment + credit memo.
eli_sales: confirm, please apply. customer is expecting the credit to clear asap.
jamie_billing: running manual grant now. commands (internal):
```sql
-- create credit memo
INSERT INTO credits (org_id, invoice_id, amount, reason, created_by) VALUES ('org_00987_novatech','INV-2024-07-889',25000,'Contract promo NT-2024-55 - manual grant', 'jamie_billing');
-- apply to invoice
UPDATE invoices SET balance = balance - 25000 WHERE invoice_id = 'INV-2024-07-889';
```
jamie_billing: done. credit memo CM-2024-9001 created, invoice adjusted. sending reconciliation to finance.
arthur_finance: got the note, I'll reconcile in the month-end batch. one ask: include the PO scan in the finance ticket so audit trail is clear.
eli_sales: I uploaded PO scan to CS ticket and added PO note to salesforce. link: https://sf.redwood/sales/lead/NT-2024-55
kristen_cs: replied to customer: we applied a manual credit and adjusted the invoice, and asked them to re-run traffic using the active enterprise key. asked them to confirm if they still see 401s.
sam_eng: found 401 spikes at 2024-05-02T14:05:12Z for that org from gateway logs — looks like requests hitting a rotated key (key_id old_k_334). after key rotation we mark old keys disabled but some clients keep using them. if they confirm they're using the new key it should be fine. also saw a brief gateway overload at 14:02Z due to a batch job; that caused a handful of 504s. we'll add an SLO note.
kristen_cs: customer confirmed they had been using the old key, switched to the new key and the 401s stopped. they still observed a single 504 earlier but no recent issues. they confirmed invoice now shows credit and reduced balance.
jamie_billing: noted. CM-2024-9001 and journal entries recorded. tagging for audit: finance_ticket FT-5567.
arthur_finance: will close FT-5567 after audit. thanks @jamie_billing for manual grant.
eli_sales: great. can we add a small internal follow-up: ensure promo auto-apply workflow handles sales-added PO notes that come after invoice generation. filing an engineering backlog ticket.
sam_eng: filing ENG-1219 to handle retroactive promo application hook. triage to infra backlog.
kristen_cs: marking CS-4521 as resolved, customer satisfied. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: [automated] thread CS-4521 marked resolved by kristen_cs at 2024-05-02T16:14:35Z
eli_sales: :thumbsup:
jamie_billing: :thumbsup:
